note: Seven nix-darwin value surfaces at the signed pre-A4 tip. Only 32-character /nix/store hash prefixes are masked; derivation names remain. Launchd scripts are hashed after that normalization, so their text and credentials are not persisted.

system.postActivation:
echo Activating home-manager configuration for johnw >&2
hmDryRunArgs=()
hmParentArgs="$(ps -p "$PPID" -ww -o args= || true)"
if [[ -v DRY_RUN || "$hmParentArgs" == *" --dry-run"* ]]; then
  hmDryRunArgs=(env DRY_RUN=1)
fi
launchctl asuser "$(id -u johnw)" sudo -u johnw --set-home "${hmDryRunArgs[@]}" /nix/store/<hash>-activation-johnw

/usr/bin/pmset -a sleep 0

echo Activating home-manager configuration for johnw >&2
hmDryRunArgs=()
hmParentArgs="$(ps -p "$PPID" -ww -o args= || true)"
if [[ -v DRY_RUN || "$hmParentArgs" == *" --dry-run"* ]]; then
  hmDryRunArgs=(env DRY_RUN=1)
fi
launchctl asuser "$(id -u johnw)" sudo -u johnw --set-home "${hmDryRunArgs[@]}" /nix/store/<hash>-activation-johnw
